title: [Python] Samples to show how to use UserProxyAgent that takes user feedback from a frontend
body:
SelectorGroupChat currently relies on UserProxyAgent to provide feedback during a run. 

We need a sample to show how to achieve this when the application is not running in a console. 

A minimal sample with Fast API and basic HTML. 

Also update agentchat_chainlit: https://github.com/microsoft/autogen/blob/main/python/samples/agentchat_chainlit to include a new example script showing how to use UserProxyAgent.

linked_prs.title: Add sample chat application with FastAPI
linked_prs.body:
Introduce a sample chat application using AgentChat and FastAPI, demonstrating single-agent and team chat functionalities, along with state persistence and conversation history management.

Resolves #5423

ai_judgment.response: Yes. This issue involves the UserProxyAgent, which is a component unique to agent systems, and requests examples for its integration with a frontend. It aligns with the agent issue criteria as it concerns agent workflows and tool-related implementation.
